claims.text: High-temperature degradation in the baseline alloy is governed by rate-limiting outward diffusion of Al through the fcc matrix.
Outwardly diffusing Al forms a protective alpha-Al2O3 scale.
Ti segregates to grain boundaries and nucleates discrete TiO2 islands.
Grain-boundary TiO2 islands disrupt oxide-scale continuity and promote spallation.
The baseline Al content is near a critical Al/Cr threshold for continuous alumina formation.
Being near this threshold produces mixed, partly nonprotective oxide layers and spallation in air.
The as-built Al0.2Co1.5CrFeNi1.5Ti0.3 alloy has a single-phase fcc microstructure.
Increasing Al from 0.20 to 0.25 raises the Al/Cr ratio above the threshold for alpha-Al2O3 formation.
At 800 °C in air, continuous alpha-Al2O3 formation is limited by Al diffusion through the high-entropy fcc matrix.
Low oxygen partial pressure suppresses continuous external scale growth and enables internal oxidation of Ti at grain boundaries.
Internal grain-boundary oxidation of Ti causes embrittlement.
The Al-enriched variant will form a continuous, adherent alpha-Al2O3 scale in air.
The Al-enriched variant will have approximately 50% lower oxidation mass gain and negligible spallation in air relative to the baseline.
The Al-enriched variant will exhibit less internal Ti oxidation in the reducing environment than the baseline.
Reduced internal Ti oxidation will result in better retention of mechanical integrity in the reducing environment.
After 100 h in air, the baseline alloy develops mixed Al2O3/Cr2O3 scales, local spallation, and mass gain greater than 1 mg/cm2.
The baseline alloy exhibits pronounced internal Ti-oxide clustering in reducing atmospheres.
The proposed mechanism applies from 700 to 900 °C, for exposures up to 100 h, and across the stated oxygen-partial-pressure range.

contradictions.description: The reducing exposure is stated as pO2 approximately 10–18 atm, whereas the lower applicability boundary is stated as 10–19 atm. If these are intended to mean 10^-18 and 10^-19 atm, the notation is malformed and the numerical limits differ.
